dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Autosomal-recessive ataxia with oculomotor apraxia type 1 (AOA1), caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in the APTX gene

Alternative 1: Ataxia with oculomotor apraxia type 2, caused by biallelic SETX variants

Alternative 2: Joubert syndrome or a related ciliopathy caused by a biallelic Joubert-associated gene defect

Alternative 3: Ataxia with oculomotor apraxia type 4, caused by biallelic PNKP variants
